reality: conversation_messages=0, conversations=0, conversation_branches=0, conversation_message_embeddings=0, project_conversations=0, llm_call_log=0, tool_execution_log=0, context_assembly_item_log=0, query_plan_log=0. Every table that would hold a user-facing reading or the LLM synthesis that produced it is empty. This is itself the single most important quality finding: NO acharya-grade reading has ever left this instrument. All judgments below are rendered against the best available PROXY — the persisted deterministic interpretive artifacts the build pipeline produces (L5 mimamsa_insight_units verdicts, mimamsa_predictions, L2 bodha_discoveries, bodha_rm_remedy_prescriptions). recommended_action: Treat the reading-quality question as UNVALIDATED by live evidence. Before any claim that the instrument reads 'at or above an acharya's level' can be made, the serve-time synthesis path (Pariprashna) must run end-to-end and persist real readings; only then can §J be tested. Until then, §J is aspirational, not demonstrated.

claim: Reading 1 (CAREER verdict): the instrument emits two mutually contradictory verdicts for the identical question_lens — 'promised (8.2/10)' AND 'conditional (4.0/10)' — with no reconciliation. Falls short of the acharya bar.
reality: For insight_id 'verdict_career_advancement', question_lens 'career_advancement', the same chart carries BOTH 'Career Advancement: promised (grade 8.2/10). Strong evidence across traditions.' AND 'Career Advancement: conditional (grade 4.0/10). Conditional — context-dependent.' An acharya renders ONE judgment and defends it; an instrument that stores 'strongly promised' and 'merely conditional' for the same question, side by side, has not judged at all — it has enumerated. The prose is a fill-in-the-blank template ('{Lens}: {word} (grade X/10). {canned sentence}') with zero chart-specific content: no graha, no bhava, no dasha, no yoga is named. This is the 'hedging that says nothing' + 'generic phrasing' failure mode in its purest form. Verdict: NOT my level, NOT above, does NOT reveal anything — it falls short.

evidence.quote: Career Advancement: promised (grade 8.2/10). Strong evidence across traditions. || Career Advancement: conditional (grade 4.0/10). Conditional — context-dependent. [same insight_id verdict_career_advancement, same question_lens career_advancement, same chart]

recommended_action: A verdict object must resolve to a single defended judgment per lens before it is served as a reading. Contradictory duplicate verdict rows must be collapsed at build time or the serve layer must refuse to render them.

claim: Reading 2 (HEALTH verdict): the health readings are canned negative stubs — 'denied (grade 1.2/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence.' — repeated across surgery, acute illness and chronic onset with no chart reasoning. Falls short.
reality: Health-domain verdicts read: 'Chronic Illness Onset: denied (grade 1.2/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence.', 'Acute Illness: denied (grade 1.2/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence.', 'Surgery: denied (grade 1.2/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence.' The identical canned tail sentence and near-identical grade attach to three clinically distinct questions. For a domain §13.9 flags as the most emotionally load-bearing (a parent's illness, one's own death), the instrument offers a bare word 'denied' plus a self-cancelling qualifier ('Mixed or insufficient evidence' — which is a statement that there is NO basis for a verdict, appended to a definite-sounding 'denied'). No graha of disease (e.g. 6th/8th lords, Mandi, Rahu), no ayurdaya, no maraka window is cited. Verdict: falls short — this is not a health reading, it is a null result wearing a verdict's clothing.

evidence.quote: Chronic Illness Onset: denied (grade 1.2/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence. || Acute Illness: denied (grade 1.2/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence. || Surgery: denied (grade 1.2/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence.

recommended_action: 'denied' and 'Mixed or insufficient evidence' are contradictory and must not co-occur; a low-n structural verdict should render as an honest 'the chart is not speaking clearly here' gap (per §13.9), not as a false-definite 'denied'.

claim: Reading 3 (MARRIAGE/relationship verdict): 'Marriage: denied (grade 1.6/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence.' — a bare, unreasoned, emotionally blunt negative on the single most-asked jyotish question. Falls short.
reality: The marriage reading in full is: 'Marriage: denied (grade 1.6/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence.' with a paired duplicate at grade 1.8. On the question a native is most likely to ask with real anxiety, the instrument returns one word ('denied') and a grade, with — again — the self-cancelling 'Mixed or insufficient evidence' tail. No 7th house, no Venus/Jupiter for a female/male native, no Darakaraka, no Navamsa lord, no dasha timing. An acharya asked 'will I marry?' who answered only 'denied, 1.6/10' would be dismissed as either incompetent or cruel. §13.9 (emotional register) is not merely unmet; it is inverted — a frightening bare negative is exactly the failure it names. Verdict: falls short, and additionally fails the emotional-register design obligation.

evidence.quote: Marriage: denied (grade 1.6/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence. [insight_id verdict_marriage, question_lens marriage, domain relationship; paired row at grade 1.8]

recommended_action: Marriage/relationship verdicts must carry the specific karaka + house + dasha grounding before serving, and difficult negatives must be paced and framed per §13.9 — never a bare 'denied'.

claim: Reading 4 (grade/label/prose INCOHERENCE): verdicts assert 'denied' at grade 5.0/10 while the prose says 'Conditional — context-dependent' — the verdict word, the number, and the sentence disagree inside a single string. Falls short.
reality: 'Education Milestone: denied (grade 5.0/10). Conditional — context-dependent.' and 'Property Acquisition: denied (grade 5.0/10). Conditional — context-dependent.' A grade of 5.0/10 with confidence band [0.35,0.65) is by construction NEUTRAL, and the prose explicitly says 'Conditional', yet the headline verdict word is the maximally negative 'denied'. Three components of one sentence contradict each other. A reader cannot extract any coherent judgment. This is worse than generic — it is internally incoherent output presented as a finding, i.e. grounded-but-wrong at the level of the render itself. Verdict: falls short.

evidence.quote: Education Milestone: denied (grade 5.0/10). Conditional — context-dependent. || Property Acquisition: denied (grade 5.0/10). Conditional — context-dependent. [confidence_band [0.35,0.65), n_support 0]

recommended_action: Fix the grade→verdict-word mapping: a 5.0/10 neutral band must not label 'denied'. Add a build-time assertion that the verdict word, numeric grade, and prose qualifier are mutually consistent before persistence.

claim: Reading 5 (WEALTH verdict): the same wealth question resolves to opposite signs — 'Major Financial Gain: conditional (2.3/10)' AND 'Major Financial Gain: denied (1.5/10)' — and 'gain' and 'loss' share one identical grade. Falls short.
reality: 'Major Financial Gain: conditional (grade 2.3/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence.' co-exists with 'Major Financial Gain: denied (grade 1.5/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence.' for the same lens; and 'Major Financial Gain' and 'Major Financial Loss' carry the IDENTICAL grade (2.3, then 1.5) — the instrument assigns the same strength to a gain and its opposite. That is a tell that the grade is not derived from any chart-specific dhana yoga / 2nd-11th lord analysis but from a shared subsystem constant. Verdict: falls short — the wealth reading cannot distinguish gain from loss.

evidence.quote: Major Financial Gain: conditional (grade 2.3/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence. || Major Financial Loss: conditional (grade 2.3/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence. || Major Financial Gain: denied (grade 1.5/10). Mixed or insufficient evidence. || Major Financial Loss: denied (grade 1.5/10).

recommended_action: Gain and loss lenses must not share a grade; each needs its own dhana/vyaya derivation. Duplicate opposite-sign verdicts for one lens must be collapsed.

claim: Reading 6 (top-ranked DISCOVERY): the instrument's highest-ranked 'discovery' for the native is a z-score artifact about its own subsystem, duplicated 5+ times verbatim, naming no astrological content. Falls short of 'reveals things I wouldn't have seen'.
reality: The composite-top discovery (rank 1.2) reads: surface='Appears as one of many sade_sati signals', depth='Stands -5.9σ from ga_sade_sati baseline (mean=0.591)', why_an_acharya_misses_it='Statistically extreme within ga_sade_sati subsystem (5.9σ) but easy to miss when chart is read holistically'. This is circular: an acharya 'misses it' because the instrument's OWN z-score is extreme — a property of the pipeline, not of the chart. It never says WHICH sade-sati fact, over WHICH bhava, in WHICH dasha, or what it MEANS for career/health/relationship (the tagged domains). The exact same six-field row is stored 5+ times. The 'reveals things I wouldn't have seen' clause of §J is precisely what discoveries are meant to satisfy, and this is the failure mode §13.8-adjacent 'data dumped, not synthesized' — a statistic surfaced without a single judgment. Verdict: falls short.

evidence.quote: surface_reading: 'Appears as one of many sade_sati signals' | depth_reading: 'Stands -5.9σ from ga_sade_sati baseline (mean=0.591)' | why_an_acharya_misses_it: 'Statistically extreme within ga_sade_sati subsystem (5.9σ) but easy to miss when chart is read holistically' [5+ identical duplicate rows, composite_discovery_rank 1.2]

recommended_action: A discovery must translate its statistic into a chart-specific astrological claim (which fact, which bhava/dasha, what it portends) before it counts as a discovery. De-duplicate identical rows. A z-score is a trigger for a reading, not the reading.

claim: Reading 7 (LATENT_INSIGHT discovery): the 'latent insights' expose raw internal signal keys ('graha_kp_lords:prana_lord') and self-referential salience/consequence scores instead of interpreting them. Falls short.
reality: latent_insight rows read: surface='Signal graha_kp_lords:prana_lord with low visibility (salience 0.272)', depth='Structurally consequential: consequence_score=1.000, non_obviousness=0.903', why_an_acharya_misses_it='Low surface salience (0.10) masks high structural consequence (1.00); falls below acharya's attentional threshold'. The instrument names an internal DB signal key and three of its own computed scores, then declares — without any jyotish content — that this is 'structurally consequential'. It never says what the prana-lord being where it is MEANS for the native's character or relationships (the tagged domains). This is the cleanest example of 'cross-domain signals surfaced without judgment — data dumped, not synthesized': the machinery is described in place of the chart. Verdict: falls short.

evidence.quote: surface_reading: 'Signal graha_kp_lords:prana_lord with low visibility (salience 0.272)' | depth_reading: 'Structurally consequential: consequence_score=1.000, non_obviousness=0.903' | why_an_acharya_misses_it: 'Low surface salience (0.10) masks high structural consequence (1.00); falls below acharya's attentional threshold'

recommended_action: Latent insights must render the astrological meaning of the surfaced signal, not its salience/consequence metadata. Internal signal keys must never appear in reader-facing prose.

claim: Reading 8 (DISTRIBUTIONAL hypothesis prose): discovery hypotheses leak raw database column names ('aspects_VEN', 'aggregate_D60', 'constituent_facts_jsonb_atomic') as if they were findings, and predict only 'distinctly unusual outcomes' without saying what. Falls short.
reality: hypothesis_text values include: 'Pattern lord_aspects_lord_per_varga:aspects_VEN is a ga_structural outlier; predicts distinctly unusual outcomes in character' and 'Pattern panchanga_special_yoga_combinations:constituent_facts_jsonb_atomic is a ga_panchanga outlier; predicts distinctly unusual outcomes in spirituality, character'. Two failures at once: (1) the prose exposes internal column identifiers ('constituent_facts_jsonb_atomic', 'aggregate_D60') that mean nothing to any reader and betray that no interpretation layer ran; (2) 'predicts distinctly unusual outcomes in {domain}' is contentless — it asserts unusualness exists but never states the outcome. One row even mismatches its own varga ('aggregate_D108' with meaningfulness_basis 'aggregate_d10'). Verdict: falls short — this is scaffolding text, not a reading.

evidence.quote: Pattern panchanga_special_yoga_combinations:constituent_facts_jsonb_atomic is a ga_panchanga outlier; predicts distinctly unusual outcomes in spirituality, character || Pattern lord_aspects_lord_per_varga:aspects_VEN is a ga_structural outlier; predicts distinctly unusual outcomes in character || Pattern aspect_parashari_per_varga:aggregate_D108 [meaningfulness_basis: aggregate_d10]

recommended_action: Hypothesis prose must be authored in astrological language with the specific predicted outcome named; internal column keys must be resolved to human meaning before persistence. Fix the D108/D10 varga mismatch (data-integrity bug in the citation).

claim: Reading 9 (CAREER-TIMING prediction): the persisted predictions are an internal event slug — 'elevated career career_discovery_event' — repeated verbatim across 40+ rows with identical windows and bands. Falls short.

claim: Reading 10 (REMEDY register): every persisted remedy is written in the second-person imperative ('Recite…', 'Donate…', 'Chant…', 'Feed crows…') — the exact 'you should do X' prescriptive drift §13.8 names as the line where an astrology product becomes exploitative. Falls short + violates §13.8.
reality: remedy_label_human values: 'Recite the Mercury beej mantra Om Braam Breem Braum Sah Budhaya Namah 108 times daily on Wednesday, facing east.' | 'Donate black sesame seeds (til), black cloth, mustard oil… Feed crows, who are Saturn's birds.' | 'Chant the Shani Ashtottara Shatanamavali… daily, especially on Saturdays.' Every one is a direct command, not the attributive register §13.8 requires ('the tradition prescribes' / 'BPHS recommends'). Compounding it, the citation is a synthetic internal slug ('G27 remedy mercury_matrix_mantra for Mercury'), not a real classical reference — so the prescriptive command is issued with 0.90 'classical_strength_rating' but no verifiable classical source. The mantras themselves are astrologically correct, which is the ONLY favorable note in this sample — but correctness of content does not rescue a register that §13.8 explicitly forbids. Verdict: falls short AND is a live §13.8 register violation.

evidence.quote: Recite the Mercury beej mantra 'Om Braam Breem Braum Sah Budhaya Namah' 108 times daily on Wednesday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period. [citation_human: 'G27 remedy mercury_matrix_mantra for Mercury', classical_strength_rating 0.90] || Donate black sesame seeds (til), black cloth, mustard oil, iron vessels, or sesame ladoos to laborers or the poor on Saturdays. Feed crows, who are Saturn's birds.

recommended_action: Rewrite remedy prose to attributive register per §13.8 ('the Parashari tradition prescribes reciting…'), and replace synthetic G27 citation slugs with real classical references before any remedy is served.

claim: CROSS-CUTTING: across every persisted interpretive layer, the instrument describes its OWN machinery (z-scores, salience, consequence scores, embedding distance, column keys) in place of reading the chart. The systemic failure is meta-commentary-instead-of-synthesis.
reality: The single pattern uniting findings 0006–0010: L5 verdicts render '(grade X/10)' + a canned tail; discoveries render 'Stands -5.9σ from baseline', 'consequence_score=1.000, non_obviousness=0.903', 'embedding_distance 0.776: Semantic meaning-vector far from chart centroid'; hypotheses render internal column keys. Not one persisted interpretive row in the sample states an astrological mechanism in the native's own chart terms — WHICH graha, in WHICH bhava, under WHICH dasha, producing WHICH lived outcome, and WHY. The pipeline computes structure impeccably (the scores, bands, falsifiers and 'why an acharya misses it' scaffold are architecturally ambitious and honest about uncertainty) but stops one layer short of the reading itself. The acharya bar (§J: 'my own level' / 'above' / 'reveals things I wouldn't have seen') is met by NONE of the 10 sampled proxy readings; the honest verdict is that the instrument, today, produces structured null-scaffolding, not readings. NOTE (fair mitigation): L5 is sealed in explicit STRUCTURAL mode per CLAUDE.md §E — these are scaffolds awaiting empirical calibration by design. That excuses the missing calibration numbers; it does NOT excuse the missing astrological PROSE, which is a synthesis-layer gap, not a calibration gap.

evidence.quote: reasoning_chain_jsonb: {"steps":[{"step":"embedding_distance","value":0.776,"description":"Semantic meaning-vector far from chart centroid"}]} — the ENTIRE reasoning chain for a top embedding_outlier discovery is one ML-distance number with no jyotish step.

recommended_action: Insert (and test) a synthesis layer that converts every structural artifact into chart-specific astrological prose BEFORE it is eligible to be served as a reading. Gate §J claims on a live eval of that prose, not on the structural scaffold that currently exists.
